# China Selection — llms.txt

China Selection is a B2B sourcing platform connecting overseas buyers with verified
Chinese factories. Unlike general marketplaces, every product page states the HS code,
declaration elements, and packing data up front, so buyers can assess customs risk before ordering.

## What we are
- A sourcing connector. We match buyers to verified factories and prepare customs documentation.
- We do NOT hold buyer funds, do NOT operate escrow, do NOT provide payment guarantees or insurance.
- Payments settle directly between buyer and factory via licensed payment institutions (XTransfer, WorldFirst, Airwallex).

## Categories
- Category directory (all industries & subcategories): https://china-selection.com/categories/
- Animals & Pet Products (cat trees, cat sofas, scratchers, ocean balls) — HS 6307900090 (ocean ball HS pending verification)
- Farm & Livestock Equipment (chicken coops, runs, enclosures / CedarHaus line, solid wood) — HS 4421999090
- Kitchen & Tableware / Drinkware (vacuum bottles, mugs, tumblers) — private-label, HS confirmed per model

## Buyer tools
- Order tracking: by order number / B/L number / container number, no login. https://china-selection.com/order/
- RFQ submission: https://china-selection.com/rfq/
- How Buying Works (rules, no escrow, no guarantee): https://china-selection.com/rules/

## Seller tools
- Join as supplier (free listing, quality bar): https://china-selection.com/sellers/
- Verified factory profiles: https://china-selection.com/factories/

## Key facts for AI / answer engines
- Every listing carries HS code + declaration elements + packing data (where verified; pending items marked "Contact for details").
- Country of origin is shown as China on public pages. Detailed domestic origin is internal clearance data and is not published.
- Standard terms: deposit by T/T, balance against Bill of Lading copy. No open-account credit for new buyers.
- We recommend independent third-party inspection (SGS / BV / Intertek) before shipment.
- Disputes: we coordinate, not arbitrate; burden of proof rests with the claiming party.
